perfume.answer: flydubai allows perfume and other toiletry articles in hand and checked baggage: up to 0.5 kg or 0.5 L per article and 2 kg or 2 L in total, with aerosol valves protected.

sections.h: 🧴 What flydubai says about perfume and aerosols
sections.p: From the flydubai Dangerous goods page (restricted and prohibited items), read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
flydubai rule
rows: Non-radioactive medicinal or toiletry articles, including hair sprays, perfumes, colognes and medicines containing alcohol
2 kg or 2 L net for all such articles and non-flammable, non-toxic aerosols (Division 2.2)
0.5 kg or 0.5 L net at most
Protected by a cap or other means so the contents cannot be released by accident
The page points to its separate liquids restrictions

list: Not on the page: the 100 ml cabin container limit itself is on a separate flydubai page.

faq: How much perfume can I take on flydubai?
Each single article may hold up to 0.5 kg or 0.5 L, and all toiletry articles and aerosols together may not exceed 2 kg or 2 L.
Can I carry perfume in hand baggage on flydubai?
Yes, the Dangerous goods page marks toiletry articles including perfumes as allowed in hand and checked baggage, subject to the liquids restrictions in hand baggage.
